details.name: Description
details.value:
Company Overview

Our company is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic technology team. We are looking for a strategic technology professional who can drive our cloud infrastructure, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes, and overall system reliability.


Job Overview

The Senior DevOps Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable and efficient cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. This role requires a deep understanding of modern cloud technologies, infrastructure as code, and automation strategies.

details.name: Responsibilities
details.value:
Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement robust cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with Terraform
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive CI/CD pipelines using to GitLab CI
  • Architect and manage containerization strategies using Cloud Managed Kubernetes
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and observability solutions using tools like Prometheus, Grafana
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and security of cloud environments across Azure and AWS
  • Collaborate with development teams to optimize application deployment processes and improve system reliability
  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation tools to enhance operational efficiency
  • Perform root cause analysis and troubleshoot complex infrastructure and deployment issues
  • Implement and maintain robust security protocols, including access management, network security, and compliance standards
  • Participate On-call activities

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Required Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps engineering roles
  • Production-grade Kubernetes projects from the scratch (proven, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes)
  • Expert-level knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation or Pulumi)
  • Advanced scripting skills (Python, Bash, Go)
  • Extensive experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Strong background in CI/CD pipeline development (Gitlab CI, Github Actions, Azure DevOps)
  • Application management using GitOps approach (FluxCD, Argo CD).
  • Expertise in configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet)
  • Advanced understanding of networking, security, and system administration
  • Experience with developing and implementing cloud spending strategies
  • Monitoring: ELK Stack, and CloudWatch


Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities
  • Problem-solving and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to work in an agile, fast-paced environment
  • Passion for continuous learning and technological innovation
  • Excellent documentation and knowledge-sharing capabilities

details.name: Advantages
details.value:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Professional certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer, or Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer preferred
  • Proven track record of successful cloud infrastructure and deployment projects

KMS Lighthouse is looking for a Global Learning & Training Team Lead to join our growing delivery team. We’re seeking an innovative, hands-on professional who can both shape our global training strategy and personally deliver it, designing programs, running sessions, and building content, while growing and leading a team across multiple locations.

You’ll be a key member of our middle management team, collaborating closely with Delivery, Support, Customer Success, Product, and all other company departments to create and implement cutting-edge learning solutions.

KMS Lighthouse is an industry leader in knowledge management, working with Fortune 500 enterprise-level customers. If you’re interested in the intersection of technology, innovation, and people development, this is the place to be.

details.name: Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead, manage, and grow a global learning & training team
  • Define and drive the global customer training strategy
  • Drive internal knowledge management initiatives
  • Innovate and modernize our e-learning platforms and methodologies
  • Execute special projects as assigned by department management

Hands-on Delivery

  • Conduct training sessions for diverse audiences: internal teams, partners, and customers
  • Design and implement comprehensive onboarding programs for new employees
  • Develop and deliver training materials in English and Hebrew
  • Build and maintain e-learning content
  • Lead and organize customer events, both physical and virtual
  • Oversee external knowledge portal management

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Must Have

  • Proven training and learning development experience, including hands-on delivery
  • Proven experience in team management
  • Experience developing and implementing e-learning solutions
  • Experience organizing and leading customer events
  • Excellent English and Hebrew, written and spoken
  • Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to engage audiences from end users to executives
  • Technology oriented
  • Strong project management capabilities
  • Strong innovative thinking, a creative approach, and problem-solving skills
  • Flexibility in working hours (global role)

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge management background
  • Experience with SaaS products
  • Experience working with enterprise customers
  • Additional languages

details.name: Description
details.value:
Join Us at the Cutting Edge of Knowledge Management

Are you passionate about building products that solve real customer problems and create meaningful business impact? Do you thrive in cross functional environments, working closely with engineering, design, sales, support, and customers to turn complex challenges into simple, elegant solutions? KMS Lighthouse is looking for a highly motivated, detail oriented Product Manager with a strong sense of ownership to lead key parts of our knowledge management platform.

In this role, you will drive the strategy and execution for core product areas, including AI powered features, helping our customers deliver better experiences to employees and end users. You will own the full product lifecycle from discovery and research to delivery, iteration, and success measurement.

details.name: Responsibilities
details.value:
• Define and lead the product roadmap for key areas of the Lighthouse platform, aligning customer needs with business goals
  • Drive the development of AI powered capabilities that enhance search, automation, and user experience
  • Collaborate with engineering and design to build scalable, reliable, and intuitive products
  • Partner with sales, customer success, and support to understand customer challenges and translate them into product solutions
  • Conduct user research, customer interviews, and market analysis to identify opportunities and prioritize work
  • Write clear, detailed product specifications and user stories that enable teams to deliver with focus and clarity
  • Drive cross functional execution from discovery through development, launch, and iteration, ensuring high quality and timely delivery
  • Own product success metrics and use data to inform decisions, improvements, and prioritization

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 3+ years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS
  • Strong technical fluency, able to collaborate closely with engineering, understand APIs, data flows, and system behavior
  • Proven track record of delivering high quality products from idea to launch in fast paced, iterative environments
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills with both technical and non technical stakeholders
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to driving outcomes
  • Highly motivated, organized, and detail oriented

details.name: Benefits
details.value: • Experience working on knowledge management, productivity tools, or customer service platforms

KMS Lighthouse is seeking an experienced R&D Director to lead our global engineering organization and drive the execution of our technology strategy.

This role is responsible for leading multiple engineering teams through experienced managers, scaling engineering excellence, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality, enterprise-grade SaaS solutions.

The ideal candidate is a strong people leader with extensive experience managing large-scale engineering organizations in a global environment.

They will play a key role in accelerating AI adoption across the engineering organization, embedding AI-driven development practices, and leveraging AI technologies to improve productivity, software quality, and innovation.

details.name: Responsibilities
details.value:
• Lead and scale the global engineering organization through engineering managers, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Define and execute the engineering strategy in alignment with business and product objectives.
  • Drive AI adoption across engineering by integrating AI-powered tools and development practices that improve productivity, software quality, and delivery.
  • Develop engineering leaders through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and organizational growth.
  • Partner with Product, Architecture, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to deliver scalable enterprise SaaS solutions.
  • Drive engineering excellence by improving development processes, operational efficiency, quality, and execution.
  • Oversee planning, prioritization, resource allocation, and execution across multiple engineering initiatives.
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends to ensure continuous innovation.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership of large engineering organizations.
  • Proven experience managing global engineering teams through engineering managers.
  • Strong background in enterprise SaaS and modern cloud technologies.
  • Demonstrated success driving AI adoption and modern engineering practices.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience building and developing high-performing engineering organizations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is an advantage.

details.value:
We are looking for a high-energy, driven Support Engineer to join our organization! KMS Lighthouse is a global industry leader in knowledge management solutions, working with Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 enterprises. Our platform empowers organizations to deliver accurate knowledge at scale, improving customer and employee experiences across complex environments.

 We are looking for a high-energy, driven Technical Support Engineer to join our growing team and play a key role in supporting our Australian customers, as well as global enterprise clients.

As a Technical Support Engineer at KMS Lighthouse, you will serve as a primary technical point of contact for enterprise customers. You will handle complex application support issues while collaborating closely with Development, DevOps, and Product teams to ensure service stability, best customer experience.

details.name: Responsibilities
details.value:
• Serve as a primary technical support contact for enterprise customers, with a focus on the Australian and APAC customers.
  • Receive, triage, investigate, and resolve support tickets
  • Perform in-depth troubleshooting of application, system, and infrastructure-related issues
  • Work closely with Development and DevOps teams on incident resolution and root cause analysis
  • Participate in onboarding, upgrades, and business continuity events
  • Conduct live troubleshooting sessions with customers
  • Maintain documentation of issues and resolutions

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 2+ years in a client-facing Technical Support or Application Support role
  • Experience supporting SaaS-based products
  • Hands-on Linux experience (logs, CLI)
  • Basic to intermediate infrastructure and networking knowledge
  • SQL scripting and database familiarity
  • Cloud experience, preferably Microsoft Azure
  • ITSM knowledge and ticketing systems (Jira – plus)
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
